messages:
Priya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need concrete next steps to prevent repeat KV eviction regressions. Short owners + dates.
Jon: +1. prioritize a tiny fast loop we can ship this week.
Priya: Fast loop: daily regression that runs 40 curated prompts hitting hot prefixes, checks p95 latency and kv-hit%. Owner: Marta. ETA: 2026-01-14.
Marta: I can own prompt curation and test harness hook. Will version the promptset and add expected_tags.
Ravi: I'll add KV-miss telemetry to the staging perf pipeline and surface a delta alert. Target 2026-01-12.
Ops-Bot: Ticket created: #4802 (daily-regression), #4803 (kv-telemetry).
Jon: Medium: expand load tests to include adversarial prefix churn and long tails. Owner: Jon. ETA: 2026-01-28.
Priya: Long-term: chaos mini-drill on staging that simulates cache thrash for 15m with safety gates. Owner: Priya. Draft runbook by 2026-01-20.
Marta: question: store golden outputs or tags? prefer tags + small snippet to avoid PII.
Priya: agreed, tags + snippets. add a `provenance` field for synthetic vs real.
Ravi: ACTION: Ravi -> add alert rule (kv_miss_spike) with 10m window, 25% delta threshold. Ticket #4804.
Priya: I'll consolidate tickets on the postmortem doc and schedule a 10m sync in Fri standup. Drop blockers here.
